description: Pixels and owners of a rectangle (w*h <= 10000). format "json" (default): base64 RGBA pixels plus runs of empty / buyer (with public display name) / house cells. format "png": the rectangle as a PNG image. Wraps GET /api/region. Wall coordinates: x 0..999 (left to right), y 0..999 (top to bottom); cell index = y*1000 + x.
name: read_region
title: Read a rectangle of the wall
